title: A Teaspoon of Neutron Star Weighs a Billion Tons

scenes.text: A teaspoon of neutron star weighs a billion tons.
That's about as much as Mount Everest.
The star itself is only about twelve miles across, but it's heavier than our whole Sun.
It's what's left behind when a giant star collapses.
Some of them spin over seven hundred times every second.
A billion tons, in one teaspoon.

description:
A teaspoon of neutron star weighs a billion tons.
That is roughly the weight of Mount Everest, packed into a star only about twelve miles wide.
What's the heaviest thing you can imagine?
first_comment: If you could stand on a neutron star, how long would you last? Bonus: the fastest known one spins over 700 times a second.
